changeSet.author: openelis-cn
changeSet.comment: Canonical codes, source systems and validity windows for interface-facing master data.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.master_data_identity (entity_type, test_id, canonical_code, source_system, valid_from, valid_to, created_by, updated_by) SELECT 'TEST', id, code, 'LEGACY_IMPORT', active_begin, active_end, 1, 1 FROM (SELECT id, upper(btrim(local_code)) code, active_begin, active_end, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY upper(btrim(local_code)) ORDER BY id) rn FROM clinlims.test WHERE local_code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(local_code) <> '') s WHERE rn = 1; INSERT INTO clinlims.master_data_identity (entity_type, sample_type_id, canonical_code, source_system, created_by, updated_by) SELECT 'SAMPLE_TYPE', id, code, 'LEGACY_IMPORT', 1, 1 FROM (SELECT id, upper(btrim(local_abbrev)) code, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY upper(btrim(local_abbrev)) ORDER BY id) rn FROM clinlims.type_of_sample WHERE local_abbrev IS NOT NULL AND btrim(local_abbrev) <> '') s WHERE rn = 1; INSERT INTO clinlims.master_data_identity (entity_type, organization_id, canonical_code, source_system, created_by, updated_by) SELECT 'ORGANIZATION', id, code, 'LEGACY_IMPORT', 1, 1 FROM (SELECT id, upper(btrim(code)) code, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY upper(btrim(code)) ORDER BY id) rn FROM clinlims.organization WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(code) <> '') s WHERE rn = 1; INSERT INTO clinlims.master_data_identity (entity_type, provider_id, canonical_code, source_system, created_by, updated_by) SELECT 'PROVIDER', id, code, 'LEGACY_IMPORT', 1, 1 FROM (SELECT id, upper(btrim(external_id)) code, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY upper(btrim(external_id)) ORDER BY id) rn FROM clinlims.provider WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(external_id) <> '') s WHERE rn = 1;
